_comment: Ordered driver-install plan (docs/driver-install-order.md). Groups are evaluated top-down: an entry joins the FIRST group (valid for the current platform) whose patterns match its Category, falling back to its Name; '*' is the trailing catch-all so nothing is dropped. Bluetooth/wireless sit ABOVE lan on purpose: MSI files BT+Wi-Fi+Ethernet all under Category 'LAN Drivers', so the radio groups must win on Name before the lan category pattern swallows them (BT-before-Wi-Fi is the load-bearing order). The storage gate matches RST/VMD/RAID names only - generic SATA/NVMe controller drivers fall to the catch-all and still install. A group with a 'condition' name is skipped entirely (entries recorded as SkippedByRule) when that condition is false - conditions are computed at runtime (DriverOrder.psm1). 'restartAfter': the pipeline forces a reboot after the group when anything in it actually installed, resuming via the elevated resume task.
